# ServiceReady

> Paste a rate card → agent-bookable storefront with PayPal deposits. Catalog amounts are HMAC-signed; agents cannot invent or tamper with prices. PayPal evidence beats client claims.

## What it is
ServiceReady turns a freelancer's messy rate card into a public storefront that humans and AI assistants can book. Buyers approve a real PayPal sandbox deposit (Orders v2 CAPTURE or AUTHORIZE) before work starts. Outside agents must hold a revocable spend-limited payment mandate before they can mint a deposit link. Status only changes from PayPal evidence (webhooks + Check PayPal fallback).

## Key URLs
- Home: https://serviceready.onrender.com/
- Judge path (demo credentials live here only): https://serviceready.onrender.com/judges
- Demo storefront: https://serviceready.onrender.com/s/maya-rao-studio
- MCP (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0): https://serviceready.onrender.com/mcp/maya-rao-studio
- Agent card: https://serviceready.onrender.com/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Health: https://serviceready.onrender.com/api/health
- Repo (MIT): https://github.com/kartiksaste123/serviceready

## MCP tools (order of use)
1. create_payment_mandate — spend_limit_usd + optional label → mandate_key
2. list_services / get_service — catalog prices only
3. get_cancellation_policy — quote verbatim from structured fields
4. request_quote — client_name, client_email, service_id, brief (never pass amounts)
5. create_deposit_link — quote_id + mandate_key → PayPal approval URL for the human
6. get_quote_status — status flips only on PayPal evidence
7. save_paypal_for_mandate / pay_deposit_with_saved_paypal — Vault v3 returning-client path (still capped)

## Money rules
- Agents cannot set price, deposit, tip, or refund amounts — overrides are rejected and audited.
- Quote amounts are HMAC-signed; each PayPal order stores a fingerprint re-checked before capture.
- Deposits ≥ $500 use intent=AUTHORIZE (held until Start work; void on free cancel).
- Final bill is PayPal Invoicing v2 (balance + optional tip line).
- Checkout buttons may offer PayPal, Venmo, and Pay Later where the sandbox buyer is eligible.
- Seller desk can export a disputes evidence pack (order / capture / auth / invoice ids, HMAC fingerprint, audit timeline) and tip out a contractor via PayPal Payouts (sandbox) when the merchant account allows it.

## Credentials
Sandbox buyer and seller desk login are listed only on https://serviceready.onrender.com/judges — never embed secrets here.

## Built with
PayPal Orders v2, Invoicing v2, Payments v2, Vault v3, Payouts, JS SDK v6, Agent Toolkit, signed webhooks · MCP · xAI Grok · AG Grid · Supabase · TanStack Start on Render
